title: Fixed Half-Retracted Pocket Door Module
description: One original fixed half-retracted interior pocket-door module. A continuous grounded two-skin wall cassette has a genuine full-height internal pocket and an open right mouth; a full header and right jamb bound the adjacent opening. One complete thick sliding-leaf appearance extends from inside the pocket into part of that opening, leaving a visibly clear remaining opening. The leaf has a real shallow recessed finger pull with a closed back. Two fixed stems and captive heads join the leaf to a continuous genuinely slotted overhead channel. This is a newly authored whole wall-pocket and one-leaf assembly, not an existing hinged or bifold kit with a changed angle. One static modular asset, zero scenes. No motion sweep, operative sliding, hardware load rating, host-wall compatibility, installation, building regulations, fire rating, acoustic performance, human passage, accessibility or structural safety certification.
